course_summary:
ISEN 689 | First-Order Optimization Methods | Fall 2026
Instructor: Marie Maros | mmaros@tamu.edu
Meets: TR | 2:20PM-3:35PM | ZACH 266
Grading: Homework assignments [100%]
Topics: SCAFFOLD, FedProx, FedAvg, local SGD, exact diffusion, Gradient tracking, primal-dual methods for distributed optimization, Adaptive step-size rules, Variance reduction, Composite problems, dual averaging, Duality, Mirror descent, Gradient descent, first order optimality, smoothness, Convexity, first-order optimization methods, geometry, operator theory, algorithmic design, centralized gradient descent, decentralized gradient descent, stochastic variants, accelerated methods, convergence theory, convergence rates, algorithm selection, deterministic first-order methods, stochastic first-order methods, performance comparison, federated optimization methods, distributed optimization, consensus, research papers
Prerequisites: Approval of instructor
